text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, mic check, mic check, one two. Loud 
and clear on this fine day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Good afternoon, good evening. It's Machan. 
For lunch today, I had the daily special. 
I made sure to eat my veggies first.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I drank black tea after the meal, but I 
held back on tea snacks. Hmph, aren't I 
good?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am recording a voice memo to send to my 
mother.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Are you eating properly? If you want to 
make your dreams come true, you need to 
stay healthy first." ...She called to tell 
me that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So... ta-da! I shall report back using 
voice memos.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I film this and send it to her, Mom 
won't have to worry, and I'll lose weight 
too. And once that's done—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to have Mom bake some Mar-chan 
cookies. I must do my best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Aston Machan's diet proved 
successful, and she returned to her 
original figure.
